cold_open_hook: The youngest world champion in Formula 1 history, a ninth title for Mercedes, and the lights of Las Vegas next.

stories.speaker: pixie
stories.headline: Antonelli: youngest world champion ever
stories.angle: The story of the season: a record-breaking title in only his second year, sealed in Mexico City.
facts: Kimi Antonelli became the youngest World Champion in Formula 1 history
He took the youngest-champion record from Sebastian Vettel by over three years
Nine Grand Prix wins and seven further podiums brought him the 2026 title
He sealed the title with third place in Mexico City, on a podium shared with Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton
He clinched it with three races still remaining
Antonelli is the first driver developed through Mercedes' junior programme to win the championship with the works team
Mercedes celebrated both titles with staff at Brackley and Brixworth on Wednesday 11 November
At the 2018 Italian Grand Prix a 12-year-old Antonelli was a grid kid in the pre-race ceremonies
unverified: Who won the Mexico City GP: our sources only say Antonelli was third on a podium shared with Verstappen and Hamilton. Don't name the winner.
Antonelli's age: not stated in our sources. Don't give it.

Kimi Antonelli and Ollie Bearman received 5s penalties for unsafe pit releases
It was Norris's third win of the season
Cadillac's Valtteri Bottas did not start after a cross-threaded rear wheel nut was found on the way to the grid
Rain returned with fewer than 10 laps remaining

facts: George Russell finished fourth and Kimi Antonelli fifth in Sao Paulo, securing the constructors' title
It is Mercedes' ninth constructors' championship and its first since 2021
Mercedes has won 12 races this season
The result draws Mercedes level with Williams on nine teams' titles
Toto Wolff is now the joint most successful team principal with Sir Frank Williams, on nine constructors' titles
Mercedes won eight straight constructors' titles from 2014 to 2021

stories.headline: Three races left, two fights still open
stories.angle: The title is settled; the fights for second in the drivers' standings and third in the teams' are not.
facts: Las Vegas is Round 21 of the 2026 season, with three races left
The race starts Saturday 21 November at 8pm local time; qualifying is Friday 20 November at 8pm
Verstappen is second behind Antonelli after eight straight podiums including three wins
Just 33 points cover Verstappen, George Russell, Lewis Hamilton, Charles Leclerc and Lando Norris
Red Bull lead McLaren by 17 points in the fight for third in the teams' championship
Williams will run a one-off chrome livery with title partner Atlassian

stories.headline: Camara keeps the Haas seat for Las Vegas
stories.angle: Byte: a tough debut, a second chance on the Strip, and an F2 title fight against Tsolov at the same time.
facts: Rafael Camara will race for Haas again at the Las Vegas Grand Prix
His debut was brought forward from 2027 after Haas split with Esteban Ocon
He finished 20th and last, two laps down, on his Sao Paulo debut
Camara leads the F2 standings by seven points over Red Bull reserve Nikola Tsolov
Ryo Hirakawa drives FP1 in Las Vegas; he scored a point with tenth in Mexico City

briefs.text: In Mexico City Liam Lawson started from the pit lane after a qualifying disqualification and finished seventh.
Checo Perez finished 17th in Mexico City on his 300th Grand Prix start.
After their Mexico run-in, Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton met Fred Vasseur in Brazil to talk it through.
Audi's appeal over Yuki Tsunoda's Monza grid position will be heard by the FIA International Court of Appeal on 25 November.
Williams will run a one-off chrome livery in Las Vegas with title partner Atlassian.
